summary: Iter 5 Centro Import — backend + frontend verified end-to-end. 7/7 backend pytest tests PASSED (10.3s) including: XLSX template download (6672 bytes, 23 headers, 'Istruzioni' sheet present); /import/immobili/parse on the downloaded template returned the exact example row (Bilocale Navigli, prezzo 215000, Intesa Sanpaolo, residuo 95000); /import/immobili/commit created a property visible via GET /api/properties with IMM- id; /import/bilancio/parse with live Claude Sonnet 4.6 correctly extracted ricavi_affitti=28500, IMU=1800, utile_netto=16100, valore_immobili=3650000, debito_mutui=1310000, patrimonio_netto=2482500; /import/bilancio/commit + GET /import/bilanci roundtrip OK; /import/banca/parse correctly populated match_canone for the 1450€ entrata against a seeded property; /import/banca/commit persisted movimenti. Frontend Playwright: login OK, sidebar 'Sistema → Centro Import' visible with AI badge, /import renders 3 tabs (Immobili active by default), download-template-btn triggered a real .xlsx download (6672 bytes via Playwright expect_download), Bilanci AI and Estratto conto tabs switch correctly and show italian dropzone copy ('Trascina il PDF o l\'Excel...', 'Carica il CSV o Excel dell\'estratto conto...').

minor.issue: Returns HTTP 500 when EMERGENT_LLM_KEY is missing or when the LLM doesn't return valid JSON. 503 Service Unavailable would be a clearer ops signal; same pattern flagged in iter 3 for /api/deals/analyze.
No de-duplication: re-committing the same Excel will create duplicate properties (different IMM- ids). Consider unique constraint on (user_id, nome, indirizzo) or a 'replace_existing' flag.
Idem — no de-duplication on (user_id, data, importo, descrizione); re-uploading the same statement will double-book movimenti. Add a hash-based dedup before insert.

issues: The 'Made with Emergent' badge in the bottom-right slightly overlaps with the page content area on 1920px width but does not block any clickable element.

action_items: Optional: change /import/bilancio/parse error responses 500 → 503 when LLM key missing, 422 when JSON not parseable, for clearer client-side handling.
Optional: add de-duplication on import/immobili/commit and import/banca/commit to make re-uploads idempotent.
Optional: add ImportImmobiliCommit row-level Pydantic validation (currently rows: List[dict] is untyped — typo-prone).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:734 parse_immobili reads workbook with data_only=True — correct for Excel files containing formulas; OK.
server.py:794 commit_immobili silently skips rows with valid=False — UI should ensure invalid rows are excluded before posting (already done client-side at ImportCenter.jsx:72). OK.
server.py:911 parse_bilancio: LLM JSON extraction has two fallbacks (raw json.loads + regex extract) — robust enough for Claude's typical output. Good.
server.py:974 parse_banca: pandas read_csv with sep=None engine='python' auto-detects delimiter — handled both ',' and ';' separators in tests. Solid.
server.py:1021 match_canone tolerance of 5€ may be too narrow if the bank credits the tenant with a small rounding (e.g., bonifico bancario fee); consider widening to 10€ or making it a parameter.

server.py:1043 commit_banca uses {**m, 'imported_at': ...} — beware: m comes from request body unchecked, a malicious client could inject arbitrary fields. Tighten with a Pydantic Movimento model with strict fields (data, descrizione, importo, tipo, match_canone).

ImportCenter.jsx:13 uses process.env.REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL — correct. Token retrieved from localStorage 'crr_token' to do raw fetch() for the download (apiClient is axios and would JSON-decode the binary). OK.
ImportCenter.jsx:44 localStorage.getItem('crr_token') is read on every download click — fine, but if token expires there's no refresh. Acceptable for MVP.
ImportCenter.jsx:398 lines total — within file-size budget.
Sidebar.jsx 'Centro Import' correctly placed in 'Sistema' section with accent=true (AI badge). Verified rendered text 'Centro Import\nAI'.

No data-testid missing on critical interactive elements: tab-import-immobili / -bilanci / -banca, download-template-btn, immobili-commit-btn, bilancio-commit-btn, banca-commit-btn, dropzone-immobili are all present.
seed_data_creation: Backend tests create+delete: 1 TEST_bulk_import property, 1 TEST_banca_match property, 1 bilancio doc, N movimenti_bancari. Properties and bilanci are cleaned up via DELETE in test fixtures. Movimenti_bancari from test_commit_banca are NOT cleaned (no DELETE endpoint exists for /api/import/banca) — leaves 2 movs per run in db.movimenti_bancari under ceo user. Consider adding DELETE /api/import/banca/{id} for cleanup.
